name: final_retrain
_purpose: Final reported numbers. Uses each model's winning sweep config (primary: dropout=0.2, weight-decay=0.01, n-compressed-tokens=16, pool=last, from s1+s2; baseline: lr=1e-3, dropout=0.1, weight-decay=0.01 default, pool=last, from s0+s3). batch-size=128/num-workers=0 kept from the sweep for consistency with the tuned lr values (both models share the same batch size, so the primary-vs-baseline comparison stays fair even though it differs from the progress report's batch=32). 3 seeds per model for mean+-std; NO --skip-test here -- this is the first and only test-set evaluation. Includes one single-seed blind-ablation run (question-only floor) for the report's Discussion/Ethics numbers.
